messages:
alex: Heads up — Vault audit events to Splunk stopped around 03:12 UTC after last night's KMS key rotation. Seeing unwrap errors in the forwarder.
sara: Ugh, can you paste the error lines?
alex: Sure, here's the main error from the audit-forwarder logs:

```
2026-03-21T03:12:07Z level=error msg=\"failed to unwrap ciphertext\" err=\"permission denied: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/audit-kms/cryptoKeyVersions/6: serviceAccount:vault-ingress@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com does not have cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt\"
```

mike: We rotated the CMK at 02:50 as part of scheduled rotation. Looks like the new key version doesn't have the vault-ingress SA binding. I assumed the key policy was inherited.
jen: Don't blast full owner perms. We should grant the minimum role. On GCP the right role for decrypt is roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter scoped to the key resource.
mike: Agreed — I'll add that binding. Also check whether the forwarder is using a key versioned name vs key ring + key. If it's pinned to a specific version we may need to rewrap older ciphertexts.
alex: Forwarder config points at the key resource (projects/.../cryptoKeys/audit-kms) but the ciphertexts in Vault's sink were generated with the previous key version. If we change permissions it should allow unwrap of existing ciphertexts (KMS decrypt uses the key version referenced in ciphertext), but if forwarder stores blob wrapped again we might want to rewrap to the latest version for future rotations.
sara: Actionable steps?
alex: Proposed quick plan: 
1) mike adds roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter binding for vault-ingress SA on audit-kms key
2) restart audit-forwarder pod (namespace infra-audit)
3) confirm events flow to Splunk 
4) schedule a rewrap pass for archived audit blobs and rotate any affected service tokens
mike: I'm on (1). Doing this now.
deploy-bot: Started rollout infra-audit/audit-forwarder v1.4.2 -> 1 instance restarting.
mike: IAM binding applied: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding audit-kms --member=serviceAccount:vault-ingress@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --location=global --keyring=infra`
jen: Good. After binding, we should test decrypt explicitly from the node before restarting the forwarder. alex, can you run a quick decrypt test?
alex: Running a smoke decrypt against an archived ciphertext via gcloud:

```
# sample command (sanitized)
gcloud kms decrypt --location global --keyring infra --key audit-kms --ciphertext-file /tmp/sample.ct --plaintext-file /tmp/sample.pt --project redwood-prod --impersonate-service-account=vault-ingress@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

alex: Decrypt succeeded locally. Restarting forwarder now.
deploy-bot: infra-audit/audit-forwarder pod infra-audit-forwarder-7b6d restarted (rolling).
mike: Restarted. Looking at forwarder logs — getting successful handshakes and audit events being forwarded again.
sara: Nice. Please record exact IAM change in the rotation ticket and add a least-privilege note.
jen: Long-term, schedule a rewrap pass + add an automated check to ensure vault-ingress retains decrypt role on future rotations. We should also avoid binding at project level.
alex: I'll open the follow-up ticket and a PR to the infra runbook with the root cause and mitigation steps. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4321 (draft)
mike: Starting rewrap job now for archived blobs (prefix vault/audit). ETA ~20m.
sec-bot: Scheduled incident: SEC-2026-045 created (type: credential-access, severity: low). Owner: alex, mike.
sara: Also add a short maintenance window to rotate the vault-ingress service account token and confirm auditing isn't broken afterwards.
jen: Agreed. Token rotation + rewrap + runbook update = closure criteria. Alex/Mike own.
alex: Will do token rotation once rewrap finishes; I'll post results here.
mike: Rewrap done. Verified 4231 blobs rewrapped to current key version. No errors.
alex: Rotated vault-ingress svc account key (short TTL), restarted forwarder again to pick up token. Splunk now shows 4.1k audit events in last 30m.
sara: Thanks — can you add the 1-line mitigation note to the KMS rotation SOP? I'll schedule the postmortem doc.
alex: Added note and linked runbook. Closing out on my side.
sec-bot: Incident SEC-2026-045 marked resolved. Postmortem placeholder created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/SEC-2026-045
jen: Thanks team. Follow-up: add an automated IAM check as part of the KMS rotation pipeline to detect missing cryptoKeyDecrypter bindings.
mike: Filed infra ticket INFRA-791.
alex: Closing thread — everything green.
